messages.subject: diffgate SPEC delivered (spec review PASS at 3 of 3)
messages.body: Brainstorm worker_status partial (adversarial gate blocked by 7 HIGH invariants, all resolved in the merge; SPEC.md passed independent review 3 of 3): diffgate is an additive command /sc:spec-panel-diffgate whose stdlib script (skill sc-diffgate) snapshots each review, computes the next review's surface as a line plus token diff, rejects findings not anchored on changed text or a prior blocking id (they become deferred: pre-existing and never block), derives blocking and the verdict itself, and refuses any reviser hunk not owned by an open blocking finding. Predicted on S1: review-3 critical+major mean about 3.0 to 3.5 with P(both replicates 3 or fewer) only about 0.2 to 0.25, and growth about 20% to 27% against the 44.4% bar, so the count bar is likely missed while growth passes. Biggest risk, verified in the flg-r1 logs: every review-3 blocker there sits on text written by fixes of blocking findings (4 fixes, 4 new blockers), which no part of this theme can lower without hiding defects, so S1 would mostly measure that per-fix defect rate; the owner must also confirm how an early scoped PASS is scored before any run (spec-review-round3.md note m7).
